spans.s:
सं-√ 1. छद् Caus. -छादयति, to cover over, envelop, conceal, hide, obscure, ŚBr.; MBh. &c.;
to put on (as a garment), Vop.
सं-√ 2. छद् (or छन्द्), Caus. -छन्दयति (only ind.p. -छन्द्य), to present, offer (with acc. of pers. and instr. of thing), MBh.
entirely covered or enveloped or clothed, MBh.; Hariv. &c.
सं-√ 2. छद् (or छन्द्), Caus. -छन्दयति (only ind.p. -छन्द्य), to present, offer (with acc. of pers. and instr. of thing), MBh.
spitting out, vomiting forth, ejecting (one of the ten ways in which an eclipse is supposed to end, cf. राहु-ग्रसन), VarBṛS.
cut to pieces, cut off &c., MBh.
to be cut through or removed or resolved (as a doubt), MBh.
सं-˚छेत्तृ mfn. one who removes or resolves (a doubt), ib.
‘the flowing together of two rivers’ or ‘the mouth of a river entering the sea’, L.
